name: Chapultepec Zoo
tagline: Starter featured guests: Xin Xin the giant panda, African lion, orangutan — Bengal tiger, Humboldt penguin.

practical.ticket_note: Often free/low-cost public zoo; expect crowds — confirm hours on CDMX sites.
